proof_audit.reason: Every journal kind has a financially specified counter-entry. The accounting identity and equity roll-forward are separate from the cash budget. Covered charge-off neutrality is conditional on enough prior allowance and follows exactly from cancelling the same charge against G and A. Recovery and any supported release are distinct events. The simple positive-allowance convention is expressly limited and is not imposed as universal accounting law.

proof_audit.claim: Complete economic value and ratio repairs
proof_audit.reason: The valuation bridge uses a common date and explicitly fixed liability values; a complete loan PV replaces its net carrying amount. Positive denominators permit the capital inequalities to be multiplied through. Because cash enters exposure, the leverage issue condition is x>=(ell U-K)/(1-ell), with ell<1. Stable-deposit conversion holds assets fixed and requires a different denominator calculation; actual conversion is limited to deposits outside scheduled outflows. Ratio requirements alone are not asserted to supply cash, severe-scenario solvency or regulatory compliance.

For the fixed deterministic plan, receipts are assumed available before each cutoff, restricted cash is unavailable throughout and no unlisted constraint is permitted. Cash conservation supplies necessity; carrying each nonnegative remainder forward supplies sufficiency. An up-front external cash injection that changes no other modeled flow shifts every prefix equally, so the largest negative prefix is the exact minimum. This proof does not optimize future facilities or eliminate the need to fund a prior missed cutoff.

The old pledged pool is excluded from new capacity. The new advance adds cash and wholesale principal while encumbering the free pool. Repayment removes principal, charges only financing interest to equity and releases only that newly pledged pool. The sale problem correctly replaces both the secured advance and repayment rather than adding an incompatible second source. New unsecured repair obligations are explicitly outside the three-cutoff horizon.

source_scope.inspection_basis: Reused the assignment's recorded actual-body inspections and reviewed the full source proposal records; this peer did not newly retrieve or claim a fresh full-body source audit.

sources.scope: 2013 UK conceptual capital/liquidity and valuation material; historical incurred-loss timing, deposit-protection levels and capital thresholds are excluded from current assertions.

source_scope.limits: All numerical cases and marks are synthetic. Correct source routing and scoped review do not establish real counterparty performance, prices, eligible collateral or legal enforceability.

numerical_review.methods: Exact rational cumulative journal reconstruction, independent liability and complete-value aggregation, cross-multiplied capital conditions, cumulative dated cash and collateral states, and explicit exercise certificates.
numerical_review.interventions: 15 focused valid groups: three3.8 repair types; cash issues3.7999999999999,1.2 and1.1999999999999 to distinguish exact gates from rounded displays; a later secured-repayment failure with a previously sufficient repair; earlier receipt12; separate allowance release/recovery/covered charge-off; changed loan weight; negative financing-rate boundary; zero economic-equity loan mark; surviving gross claims with zero net book loans.
numerical_review.boundary_evidence: At a displayed rounded capital amount near3.8 or cash headroom near zero, exact unrounded booleans still reject insufficient inputs. A sufficiently expensive secured repayment can move the first failure to cutoff3 even after the first two cutoffs pass. Fully allowed but surviving gross claims may have positive stipulated value; absent assets may not.
numerical_review.invalid_inputs: 23 independent API rejection cases cover strict numeric types/nonfinite/bounds, schema, balanced opening, insufficient allowance, unsupported release, unknown fields, ratio denominators, restricted cash, draw timing, loan/liability budgets, stable-deposit conversion and all five absent-inventory valuation categories. Rejections are nonmutating.
numerical_review.portable_contract: Only candidate model/input files are needed by normal and-O CLI tests from a different directory. Default output is strict JSON; --output is quiet. Direct, symbolic-link and hard-link output targets for the input/model reject and preserve bytes. Duplicate keys, nonfinite constants and oversized serialized input reject before overwriting an existing output. Import/run/check APIs are quiet and JSON-safe.

remaining_limits: A fixed deterministic cash plan with stated pre-cutoff receipts does not model unlisted intra-cutoff sequencing, margin calls, collateral reuse, taxes or new facilities.
Twelve-place output rounding can hide small differences; gate flags use exact internal values, and the peer explicitly tested near-boundary discrepancies.
Positive toy ratios or executable cash prefixes do not imply legal capital compliance, future funding beyond the horizon or positive economic equity under every mark.
Separate machine-assisted peer review is not external human certification or empirical verification of the fictional contracts.
